notes.title: Update 2.0.4
notes.content: [p][/p][h1]Greetings Asfalians![/h1][h3]A new playable version of Asfalia Fear is now available![/h3][p]This build includes several new features, tweaks and fixes (especially to the controls) that we can't wait to share with you![/p][h3]Gamepad control improvements[/h3][list][*][p]The right stick now makes it easier to find interactive objects in the scene[/p][/*][*][p]The left stick is still used to move Charlie[/p][/*][*][p]An automatic tutorial has been added for moving around and for Lily's mini-game[/p][/*][*][p]The ghost invader's gamepad controls have been reworked[/p][/*][*][p]The size of the gamepad cursor has been standardized so that it no longer depends on screen size.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Other improvements[/h3][list][*][p]The resolutions offered in the screen configuration now adapt dynamically to supported resolutions.[/p][/*][*][p]Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese added to language options.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Bugs solved[/h3][list][*][p]Pressing ESC during ghost invaders correctly pauses the game and displays the pause menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Russian logo correctly localized[/p][/*][*][p]Numerous minor bugs[/p][/*][/list][h2]Test our new build now![/h2][p]We're counting on you to test this new build and give us your [b]feedback on the tutorial and the new game controls[/b].[/p][p]You can [b]report a bug[/b] using the /bug command in the [url="https://discord.gg/5cB9VmAW"]Discord server[/url].[/p][h2]Do you speak Chinese?[/h2][p]We're looking for playtesters who speak traditional and/or simplified Chinese to help us with the translation of the game. If this is your case, don't hesitate to contact us on our discord server.[/p][p]If you are interested, please fill in this form : [/p][p][url="https://forms.gle/2Jyx7m7Wm8sVFJQK6"]https://forms.gle/2Jyx7m7Wm8sVFJQK6[/url][/p][p][/p][p][i]We look forward to hearing from you![/i][/p][p][i]~ The Funtomata team[/i][/p]

notes.title: 2.0.2 Beta
notes.content:
- Fixed issues when touch input and controller input are used at the same time
- Added a dead zone to analog stick controls

notes.title: Playtest for 1.0.3 is Live
notes.content:
We added more supported languages: German, Spanish, Brasilian, Japanese and Russian

There's also a few other QoL features:
- Windowed mode support
- Flash deactivation (white flashes are replaced with black flashes)
- Screenshake deactivation

Please test away and let us know if you see any mistakes

We're actively working on controller support, that will be the next thing, but it's not ready yet

notes.title: Double update full of features
notes.content:
[h1]Ghost Invaders Leaderboard[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45247138/f94938d4ee166862c7165bb8f98adb972eceff81.png[/img]

Ghost Invaders now features a leader board with different ladders

[list]
[*] Asfalia: Your profile's best score compared to the inhabitants of Asfalia
[*] Local: Your profile's best score compared to other profiles on the same device
[*] Friends (steam only): Your steam account's best score compared to your steam friends' best score
[*] World (steam only): Your steam account's best score compared to the world.
[/list]

[h1]Chapter Selection[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45247138/e2c6246328aef61152ca674a75479dd75b675677.png[/img]
You can now revisit different sections of the game to try and find any stickers you might have missed.

Practically speaking, the story is now divided in 7 different chapters and whenever you reach one of those milestones, the state of your game will be recorded in a snapshot. This means that, if you've already finished the game when this feature is rolled out, you'll have to play through the game one more time to properly unlock each chapter.

Time to hunt those last remaining stickers.

[h1]Credits[/h1]
We've added the game's credits to the main menu. Discover all the people who've contributed to the game, along with some cool music and some visual treats.

[h1]Esc Key Support[/h1]
Pressing the "Esc" key now can open/close the pause menu in-game or navigate back to the previous menu page. Also works in the Ghost Invaders minigame

[h1]Fixes and improvements[/h1]

Beyond those features, here's a few fixes and improvements

[list]
[*] The fast forward feature now consistently allows to fast forward any dialogue
[*] Added some cosmetic interactions
[*] Added some sounds and musics
[*] Lily will no longer repeat herself every time a drone is fixed
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes for Version 0.9.5
notes.content:
[h1]0.9.5 Release Note[/h1]

For this release we worked on a few Quality of Life updates as well as fixing various sound issues.

[h2]Global[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed issues with several voice lines being cut off. Kniferatu will now successfully finish his birthday joke.
[*] Lily no longer makes an annoying fiery sound when moving around.
[*] Charlie no longer walks on air in some places.
[*] Charlie now has a more appropriate facial expression in some parts of the game.
[*] Fixed some character orientations during dialogues.
[*] Fixed some dialogue UI positioning issues.
[*] Added some cam shakes.
[/list]

[h2]Menus[/h2]
[list]
[*] After creating a new profile you no longer have both options to "Play" and "Start a new game."
[*] When closing the stickers book while a "new sticker" animation is playing, the animation stops.
[*] The in-game menu will now always be hidden during dialogues.
[*] There's now a "credits" button in the main menu (though it doesn't do anything yet).
[*] In-Game UI is now responsive regardless of screen resolution.
[/list]

[h2]Game[/h2]
[list]
[*] If you quit the game forcefully while a puppy is going to prison, the state is correctly saved.
[*] Charlie reacts to Cerberus pouncing in the cemetery.
[*] There are much fewer stars in the sky during the investigation.
[*] The birthday presents no longer have a sudden twitch when being claimed.
[*] Candles in the frozen garden now have a flicker animation.
[*] The vultures' wings stop flapping when pausing the dialogue after Loki is caught by the shadow.
[*] It's now possible to re-click on the star in the Mansion after activating it for the first time.
[*] Fixed some issues that happen if you enter the manor when media is there, and then leave the manor and come back again.
[*] Fixed an issue causing the drone in Echo Town to be non-interactable.
[*] It is now possible to Quit the ghost invaders game directly after fixing it (Kniferatu won't be impressed, of course).
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes 0.9.4
notes.content:
In this update we fixed a lot of issues related to "paused dialogues" mode where animations aren't looping properly and speech bubbles were showing too early.

[h2]Visuals[/h2]
[list]
[*]The swing's shadow in the playground no longer flickers
[*]Fixed various speech bubbles issues
[*]Fixed some ordering issues
[*]The wolf will no longer wear his chimera costume when fished out of the pond
[*]The door leading to the manor in the frozen garden is now in higher resolution
[*]Some idle animations were not properly looping after speaking with a character
[/list]

[h2]Bugs[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed bugs with some achievements
[*]Fixed the positioning of some stickers in the stickers book
[*]Fixed some issues happening when play mode is set to "paused dialogues"
[*]In-Game menu now properly re-activates after dialogues
[*]Kiri now properly turns towards Charlie when showing the wand
[*]Fixed a bug allowing to speak with Kniferatu about the wolf during the birthday before finding his hideout.
[/list]

[h2]Sound[/h2]
[list]
[*]Some sounds were not properly playing at the user-defined volume
[/list]

[h2]Others[/h2]
[list]
[*]Changed some drones patrolling path to avoid bumping into other characters
[*]The drones and wand minigames are now replayable via the "mini-games" menu
[*]In-Game menu will now always be hidden during dialogues
[*]Added some cosmetic interactions with the environment
[*]Fixed some lip syncing issues
[*]The wolf will be easier to find during the birthday for those who don't fish it out of the pond
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.9.3 Release Notes
notes.content:
This update, we've finally added all the stickers, added missing sounds, and fixed some save inconsistencies along with a blocking issue with the Ghost Invaders game.

[h2]General[/h2]
[list]
[*] All stickers have been added to the game. You should no longer receive blank stickers.
[*] Fixed some typos in the French dialogues.
[*] Achievements were added to the game (not available on the playtest or demo versions).
[*] The "clickzone" button in the top left corner should no longer appear.
[/list]

[h2]Bugs[/h2]
[list]
[*] In Ghost Invaders, under certain conditions still unknown to us, the game stops spawning enemies, forcing the players to quit the game. We haven't found why this happens yet, but we've now added a timer that will force enemy spawning to resume after one minute if it happens.
[*] After fixing a drone, if you leave the game and resume the game, it will no longer revert to its broken state.
[*] Weather will still be bad when quitting and returning to the game after the puppies have disappeared.
[/list]

[h2]Sounds[/h2]
[list]
[*] Some missing sounds were added.
[*] The music volume should now be slightly lowered during dialogues.
[*] Some of the ghosts' dialogues in French were abnormally muted.
[/list]

[h2]Visuals[/h2]
[list]
[*] The TV screens in Echo Town are now more lively.
[*] Some ordering issues were fixed (not all, but we'll fix that in the next update).
[/list]

notes.title: Release Notes 0.9.1
notes.content:
[h1]Release notes version 0.9.1[/h1]
From now we will do bi-weekly updates until release.

For those wondering about some stickers not displaying properly, it's because we're still working on them. They will be rolled out progressively over the course of the next weeks.

[h2]General[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added / updated the music in some scenes
[*] Reworked some texts in the UI
[*] Reworked the timing of some animations
[*] Fixed some lip sync issues
[/list]
[h2]Bugs[/h2]
[list]
[*] After the final scene you will return to the main menu instead of getting a black screen
[*] Fixed a blocking bug where in some cases, kniferatu wouldn't cut the cheese
[*] Fixed a bug where sometimes the drone in echo town would appear to be fixed when it's supposed to be broken
[*] The blue ghost in the frozen garden will not try to scare you again after the first time
[*] Lily no longer teleports after the encouragement mini-game
[*] Charlie no longer talks about weird symbols when clicking on pupmpkins before the pumpkins puzzle is activated
[*] The unlit brasier in the frozen garden now stays lit after lighting it up
[*] The shadow no longer disappears during the final fight
[*] If you leave the woods and go back to them, Charlie's arrival animation won't be played again
[*] Fixed some issues with non-pausable speech bubbles
[*] Fixed some fading issues with French voice lines
[*] Fixed an issue where Charlie would speak english when playing in french
[/list]
[h2]Visuals[/h2]
[list]
[*] Improved the visuals on some assets
[*] Solved some sprite ordering issues
[*] Vultures are no longer hidden in the fog during the wand trial if you haven't lit the snake's
[*] Reduced the lights strength on the portal in the frozen garden
[*] The camera correctly follows the star when clicking on a pumpkin during the pumpkins puzzle
[*] Added a flicker to Lily when we meet her
[*] Improved the "claimed sticker" animation
[*] Made the woods' exit easier to identify
[*] The TVs in Echo Town now change their display after chasing the shadow
[/list]

[h2]Others[/h2]
[list]
[*] Moved one of the drones in the frozen garden to a less obvious location
[*] Changed how one of Kiri's stickers is obtained to avoid spoiling the player as to her identity
[*] Added a secret sticker (no, I'm not telling you what it is)
[/list]
